purpose: Supply independently obtained abstracts for second-stage screening of the 50 DBLP candidates absent from both prior comparison sets. This is screening support, not a new topic search or a publisher-native result.

input.selection: Unique DOI-bearing records where already_in_reference_metadata and already_in_openalex_probe are both false, in source-artifact record order.

full_text_routing.input: The 34 records with model_recommendation=retain_for_full_text in dblp-screening-triage-2026-08.csv, in file order.
full_text_routing.interpretation: Open-access status routes full-text verification; it is not an inclusion criterion. Closed records can still be adjudicated from authorized access or bounded abstract-level claims.

retention_boundary: No OpenAlex abstract text is redistributed in the companion. The record-level triage file retains only source identities, stages, recommendations, and bounded rationales. Final author decisions remain blank until adjudication.
interpretation: Exact-DOI enrichment supplied abstracts for screening known records. It does not estimate topic-search recall, make DBLP equivalent to Scopus, or convert model recommendations into admissions.
